messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] 2026-03-14T15:12:01Z - High 99p latency on /v1/embeddings for prod-region-us-east. Alert: embeddings.latency.99p > 1200ms (triggered)
Maya P.: paging oncall now — I’m looking. noticing traffic spike to dedicated-pool-3 around 15:10 UTC.
Alex C.: seeing lots of QPS to bigger models and sticky routing sent to quantized-gpu-variant which is thrashing, OOM retries in logs.
Tony R.: grabbing logs — reproducer: repeated KV-cache misses + kernel fallback. attaching snippet:
Tony R.: ```
2026-03-14T15:10:45Z ERROR serve: exec failed: cuda OOM, retrying with smaller batch
2026-03-14T15:11:12Z WARN  batching: queue-depth spikes to 480
```
Kim O.: telemetry shows autoscaler delayed due to daemon heartbeat gap, scale-up request queued for 2m. maybe race with node maintenance.
eng-runtime-bot: Found candidate mitigation: route embeddings requests to fallback model variant "embed-fast-8bit" (lower throughput but consistent latency). Runbook: `POST /internal/routing/override {target: "embed-fast-8bit", timeout: 30m}`
Maya P.: applying routing override now. @alex please confirm no compatibility issues for existing embeddings consumers.
Alex C.: compatibility OK, variant returns same dims and schema. applying override took ~18s.
Elena (CS): We're getting inbound tickets from 3 customers reporting slow searches — I flagged CS playbook and sent interim notice: "Experiencing slower embeddings, mitigation in progress."
Sasha (Product): Can we estimate customer impact window so I can update status page?
Maya P.: initial impact window ~15:10–15:28 UTC. mitigation cut 99p from ~1600ms -> ~420ms.
Tony R.: autoscaler is back; nodes came up at 15:26 but initial warmup caused kernel churn until 15:34.
Maya P.: closing page, monitoring for 15m before final clear. paging cleared at 15:36 UTC.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by Maya P.; severity reduced to S2 at 15:38:12Z.
Kim O.: root cause hypothesis: simultaneous maintenance + an aggressive routing policy that favored quantized variant under capacity assumptions. autoscaler didn't react fast enough due to heartbeat jitter.
Alex C.: short-term actions taken: routing override, manual node add, CS notification. Good.
Sasha (Product): schedule postmortem pls. propose tomorrow 09:30 PT for 60min and include eng-runtime, oncall, infra, CS, product.
Maya P.: I can run initial postmortem notes. action item list below from convo — will own tracking: 1) Add routing safeguards to detect variant thrash and auto-fallback (owner: Alex C.) 2) Adjust autoscaler heartbeat thresholds and alert if scale request pending >60s (owner: Kim O.) 3) Create canary for node maintenance to prevent simultaneous maintenance and critical pools (owner: Tony R.) 4) Update runbook to include explicit fallback command and who to notify in CS (owner: Maya P.) 5) Re-evaluate paging thresholds for brief spikes -> propose require sustained >3m for S1 pages (owner: Sasha)
Elena (CS): request: add templated customer notice for degraded embeddings with timeline and mitigation steps. I’ll draft and send for review.
Alex C.: PR created for routing safeguard prototype: `github.com/redwood/serve/pull/4872` — includes detection for repeated OOM retries in 60s window -> trigger auto-fallback. link: https://github.com/redwood/serve/pull/4872
Tony R.: infra task filed: INFRA-1291 "prevent concurrent maintenance on critical dedicated pools". will propose maintenance quorum check.
Maya P.: scheduling postmortem: created calendar invite for 2026-03-15T16:30:00Z UTC (09:30 PT) — agenda: timeline, root cause, action owners, SLO impact. please add notes/attachments.
Sasha (Product): SLO hit: embeddings 99p SLO is 900ms — we breached for ~18 min. need to log customer-exposed SLO outage and run impact calc for billing/credits if any.
Kim O.: monitoring changes proposed: 1) Add derived metric `routing.variant_retries` and alert when >10/min; 2) Change alert `embeddings.latency.99p` to require sustained 3-min window before S1 page; 3) Add circuit-breaker metric for autoscaler queue length.
Maya P.: good — please add these as follow-up tickets and link them in postmortem.
Alex C.: also recommend adjusting our noise rules: low-volume transient spikes should create ops-notes not pages. set severity mapping: sustained 3m -> S2, sustained 10m or customer-impacting -> S1.
Elena (CS): request to be added to the postmortem distribution so we can prepare customer comms.
Maya P.: added Elena and Sasha to the postmortem doc. I'll post the draft root-cause timeline and attach logs + scaled metrics.
eng-runtime-bot: created postmortem doc at https://docs.internal.redwood/postmortems/pm-1772504321 (locked for edits until owner unlocks).
Tony R.: quick follow-up — we should add an automated smoke after scale-up: run `curl /health/embeddings?mode=warmup` across new nodes to prime kernels. adding task INFRA-1293.
Maya P.: final note: no data loss, requests were retried transparently, CS to review affected customers, no credits recommended yet until impact calc. closing thread — will capture action items in postmortem and update tickets. :white_check_mark:
